lines.en: Artificial intelligence is already changing the way we work, and it will probably change it even more.
In the future, I think most people will work from home, because meetings can be held online.
Smartphones have made our lives easier, but they have also made it harder to disconnect from work.
Self-driving cars are being tested in several countries, although many people still do not trust them.
My grandfather could not believe that you can see someone's face while talking to them on the phone.
If robots do more of the boring jobs, people will have more time for creative and social activities.
It is important to protect your personal data, because companies collect far more information than you realize.
Online learning has opened doors for millions of people who could never afford to study abroad.
Technology is only a tool, and whether it helps or harms us depends on how we choose to use it.
By the time my children grow up, many of today's jobs will probably not exist anymore.
